why: Both answers make the same correct call: take paid pre-orders before spending two weeks on production. Advice 1 is tighter. It gives a clear stop-or-go rule (3 or more paid in a week to go ahead, 1 or fewer to stop) and flags the legally required seller disclosure for online sales in Japan (特定商取引法表記). Advice 2 leaves a gray zone between its thresholds ('数件') and its bar of 10 or more pre-orders is somewhat arbitrary.
